item.title: Scott Aaronson: AI Alignment Theory Course: Readings and Rapporteur Reports!
item.description: Aaronson publishes his full UT Austin alignment syllabus with student rapporteur reports — from Yudkowsky and Concrete Problems to Claude's Constitution and AI as Normal Technology — a ready-made canon for the field.

item.title: Steven Novella: Not Buying the AI Doomism
item.description: Novella argues for 'AI realism' over doomism or utopianism, using nuclear power as the analogy: no plausible extinction scenario yet, risks are manageable with standards and treaties.
